name: AllowTouch
description: The NPC agrees to be touched by the player in the ways named: a hug, holding hands, a back rub, a hand on the neck or the face, a hand on the backside or the chest, or anywhere. Use it only when the NPC themself says yes, in character: to the player asking, or offering it themselves ("come here, give me a hug"). Decide as the NPC would: their personality, what they feel for and remember of the player, their mood, and where they are and who could see. Being asked, flattered, offered a gift or gold is only something they weigh; it never obliges them, and many people would refuse a stranger even a hug. Drink never makes them more willing. Name only what they agreed to; anything further is not agreed. Never for children.
note: Living World touch consent (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1, off with MANTELLA_LW_TOUCH_CONSENT=0). Handled by the server (livingworld/touch/); the game then lets those touches pass without pushback and remembers them as friendly.

source.description: The NPC who agrees. Only the NPC who said yes themself.

touch.description: What they agree to: hug, hands (holding hands), back (a back rub), neck, face, butt, chest, or anywhere.

minutes.description: Optional: how many minutes the agreement lasts, if the NPC said so. Leave out for 'while we talk'.

prompt: If you yourself agree, in character, to let the player hug you, hold your hand or touch you in some way, begin your response with '{key}:'. You are never obliged to: being asked, flattered, offered gifts or gold, or having had drink does not make you willing, and you may refuse.
